business_problem: OUH wanted to enable its staff to innovate with generative AI technologies in a safe, secure, and compliant way.
solution_summary: Oxford University Hospitals built its Microsoft solution to improve employee-productivity and operational workflows. OUH wanted to enable its staff to innovate with generative AI technologies in a safe, secure, and compliant way. Key components included Microsoft 365 Copilot delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Microsoft Power Platform coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through Microsoft 365 Copilot, processed by Microsoft 365 Copilot, and then delivered through Microsoft 365 Copilot so Oxford University Hospitals can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. Admin time saving of 2-3 hours per week More efficient working for teams Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (OUH) is one of the UK's largest teaching hospital trusts.
